problem: Fresh original T1 review found detached causal joins and semantic/content hash auditing incomplete; unchanged current sources independently confirm the cited control-flow gaps.

issues.title: History receipts are not bound to their request or resulting state
issues.trigger: In an otherwise decodable new bootstrap/supervision history item, change request.payload.event_key to a fresh nonempty key, leaving transaction.event_key and both operation hashes untouched; alternatively replace resulting_record_hash with another 64-character lowercase hash.
issues.consequence: The history still passes these checks although its declared request/result no longer matches its receipt. Revision equals only the number of items; it does not prove pre/post state causality.
issues.evidence: Lines 527–542 validate request and original, compare transaction only against decision, format-check resulting_record_hash, and read the request event key for duplicate detection. No request-operation digest, transaction event key, expected-record link, or resulting-state comparison is made. Callers at 627–628 and 697–698 use only the returned count.
issues.remedy: Within detached history validation, bind the permitted request tag and canonical operation to the recorded decision/transaction, event identity and acyclic pre/post state references. Validate/rederive the recorded state chain without live issuers or wall-clock calls. Add focused negative cases for independently altered request/event/result links.

issues.title: Diagnostic timestamps select whether a publication content hash is verified
issues.trigger: For the currently exercised local publication fixture, set diagnostics.utc to {}, then change payload.publication_hash to a different valid SHA256 string without changing content.
issues.consequence: The native local branch accepts an unverified declared publication hash. Removing logging-only timestamps also changes validation semantics. Nested route produced_publication_hash can then merely repeat that unverified value.
issues.evidence: Lines 750–757 reconstruct the legacy publication only when both UTC keys exist. The local branch at 411–416 strips schema/original_time and never recomputes publication_hash; its later loop at 457–458 checks only hash shape. Actual comparison exists exclusively in the legacy branch at 423–426.
issues.remedy: Define and validate the new publication canonical hash consistently, excluding only its self-hash according to the frozen acyclic contract, regardless of diagnostic presence. Keep archival legacy hash validation explicitly separate. Cover both empty diagnostics and preserved diagnostics, including local nested budget histories.

issues.title: Route semantic and source hashes are accepted as arbitrary labels
issues.trigger: In any otherwise accepted local route record, replace payload.semantic_hash or payload.source_key with any different well-formed SHA256 string.
issues.consequence: The decoded record claims semantic/source identity that disagrees with its embedded input, defeating T1's semantic hash audit even though input_hash itself remains checked.
issues.evidence: The generic loop at 593–595 only verifies *_hash shape. The complete route branch at 773–816 checks input_hash but neither recomputes semantic_hash nor source_key, despite explicit local input methods existing in visual_verification.py:734 and :750.
issues.remedy: Use the exact tagged detached input decoder and established tag-specific canonical algorithms to recompute both identities, preserving legacy definitions for archival input. Add independent mutations for each declared hash, including nested local inputs.

issues.title: Nested budgets can carry a different immutable origin than their enclosing history
issues.trigger: Supply a local route whose before/after local budget envelopes share the same task_id, sequential revisions and allowed counters, but whose internally valid original_time/reference belongs to another origin. Likewise, a publication can contain internally valid local budget envelopes with the same task_id but different original_time.
issues.consequence: A detached history can attribute budget consumption to the wrong original obligation while passing individual-envelope validation. Matching task text and nonincreasing limits do not preserve original authority causality.
issues.evidence: _audit_pool at 506–508 discards each local envelope's original_time and returns semantic content. Lines 803–812 compare only task/revision/counters/limits, not original_budget_reference or enclosing original. _audit_publication at 441–452 similarly reduces nested local budgets to task_id. Local state validation only binds each budget to its own envelope at 608–611.
issues.remedy: Retain tagged envelope causality during nested auditing and join local input, publication, before/after budget and enclosing immutable original references. Reject rebinding even where task names and numeric limits match. Preserve explicitly separate legacy archival semantics.

issues.title: A recorded VALID decision can precede its own original events
issues.trigger: Use valid nonzero-origin references and a valid broker segment, but set app_current lower_ns/upper_ns to an earlier counter value in the same app domain and lease_observation.current to an earlier value than segment acquisition in its own domain. Leave the two statuses and disposition VALID.
issues.consequence: The detached validator accepts temporally impossible positive evidence because being before the expiry is the only temporal condition it checks. This is an audit-causality defect, not proof that the record grants live permission.
issues.evidence: _bracket at 138–146 checks only lower <= upper. VALID checks at 304–314 enforce upper deadline bounds; they do not ensure current follows original app origin/required reference events or lease acquisition/segment. _join_decision at 318–336 checks identities and descriptors without the missing order relations.
issues.remedy: Validate the same-domain recorded causal lower bounds required by the frozen P5 descriptor semantics as well as expiry bounds; never compare app numbers with lease numbers. Add nonzero-origin negative fixtures and valid overlap/boundary controls based on the exact P5 event ordering contract.

issues.title: Null scope bypasses the exact semantic scope guard
issues.trigger: Set payload.scope=null in a bootstrap definition or another scoped local payload, preserving the required field.
issues.consequence: A schema advertised as strict accepts a scope that is neither its required tag nor a valid string.
issues.evidence: The guard tests scope is not None before checking equality; no later scoped-field type check rejects null.
issues.remedy: For tags whose exact field set contains scope, require equality unconditionally and add a null-scope negative case.

issues.title: Typed nested-history accessor behavior is not covered by the seven executed nodes
issues.trigger: The R173 verification_budget_history/retry_budget_history and LocalRetryBudgetRecord typed accessors are changed, but the seven cases build publications from legacy nested budget payloads and compare serialized envelopes only.
issues.consequence: Successful roundtrips do not establish that the new local nested getter route works or that it rejects unsupported tags. No runtime failure of these getters is asserted here.
issues.evidence: _b_decode_domain at 2573 routes retry-budget through generic LocalEnvelope; the roundtrip assertions at 2626–2630 call to_payload only. New getters are at visual_owner.py:487 and :508. actual-evidence.json:43 explicitly reports no targeted R173 accessor execution.
issues.remedy: Recommend exact focused follow-up validation for both local and legacy nested budget variants, unsupported-tag rejection, returned concrete types and immutable/detached exports, without starting a live budget or broadening into T2/T3.
